queries.title: test
queries.gherkin:
Given stocks from list 20MICRONS
When let close = latest in 1 samples of day close
Then list sads = tickers with close > 1000
queries.regex:
Given ^stocks from list (.+)$
When ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
Then ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$

queries.title: Movers
queries.gherkin:
Given stocks from index nifty100, nifty100lowvolatility30, nifty100quality30, nifty200, nifty200alp, nifty200moment, nifty200quali, nifty50, nifty1, nifty1multicap50, niftyauto, niftybank, niftycommodities, niftyconsumerdurables, niftycpse, niftyenergy, niftyfmcg, niftyindiadig, niftyindiamanufactu, niftyit, niftylargemidcap250, niftymedia, niftymetal, niftymicroca, niftymidcap100, niftymidcap150, niftymidcap150moment, niftymidcap150quality50, niftymidcap50, niftymidcapse, niftymidsmallcap400, niftymnc, niftynext50, niftyoilgas, niftypharma, niftypse, niftypsubank, niftyrealty, niftysmallcap100, niftysmallcap250, niftysmallcap50, niftytotalma
When let open = latest in 1 samples of day open
* let close = latest in 1 samples of day close
* let high = latest in 1 samples of day high
* let low = latest in 1 samples of day low
Then let condition = (close - open) / open 
* list upMovers = tickers with condition > 0.05
* list downMovers = tickers with condition < 0 and abs(condition) > 0.05
* let dayLength = high - low
* list hammer = tickers with close - low > 0.6 * dayLength and open - low > 0.6 * dayLength
* list invertedHammer = tickers with abs(high - close) > 0.6 * dayLength and abs(high - open) > 0.6 * dayLength
queries.regex:
Given ^stocks from index (.+)$
When ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
Then ^let (\w+) = (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$
